review_comment: The code extracts prevTxId from user-provided transaction data and uses it directly to fetch another transaction via external API. This exposes the transaction fetching resource to user-controlled inputs, violating access controls. Add validation or rate limiting on input_txid before using it to initiate external transaction retrieval.

The code extracts transaction IDs from inputs and uses them to fetch parent transactions without validation. If txids are attacker-controllable, this could lead to unintended resource access patterns. The system should validate txid format and content before using them as inputs to external data retrieval functions.
